title: Kash Pashootan's Top Picks: Feb. 6, 2018
text:
Kash Pashootan, CEO and chief investment officer at First Avenue Investment Counsel
Focus: North American dividend stocks and portfolio construction
MARKET OUTLOOK
"We've had well-below average volatility over the last six years; in fact, 2016 was the lowest volatility read ever in history. So we knew it was coming back and obviously it's something we haven't been used to, but I dont think the market is behaving in any way that's outside of the norm of how equities should."
TOP PICKS
Kash Pashootan's Top Picks Kash Pashootan, CEO and chief investment officer at First Avenue Investment Counsel, shares his top picks: Magna International, Broadcom and National Bank of Canada.
MAGNA INTERNATIONAL ( MG.TO )
Good valuation; leveraged in key areas like electrification, technology and safety. BROADCOM ( AVGO.O )
Chip industry ripe for consolidation and Broadcom is at the forefront. Good valuation for high growth. NATIONAL BANK OF CANADA ( NA.TO )
Top performing bank in Canada for 2016 and 2017. Smaller size and lower loan-to-deposit ratios means National Bank is well positioned for continued lending growth.
